description.en: Adds a party member silently (no message/jingle), setting up their position lock, Fighting Spirit enable/lock flags, and optionally their level, via CMND_ADD_PARTY and its follow-up CMND_SET_*_FLAG calls. Does nothing extra if CMND_ADD_PARTY fails (returns a non-positive handle).
Param ID of the character to add to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's Fighting Spirit.
Whether to lock the member's Fighting Spirit.
Level to set for the new member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Adding a party member without changing their level (real usage, from ev42010100.nut)
examples.code:
// Add a party member silently, without a message or jingle, keeping their current level
AddParty("para_cp0008", true, false, false);

examples.case: Adding a party member and setting their level (real usage, from ev42020900.nut)
examples.code:
// Add a party member silently and set their level to 6
AddParty("para_cp0010", true, false, false, 6);
